label: urgency-targeted-2026-11-16-c
authorization: One bounded general urgency correction; preserve failures; only necessary targeted checks; no full30 or features; stop on first targeted failure.

change.old: Use Urgent only when the actual message contains genuine near-term time pressure requiring prompt attention, such as action needed today, within hours, before an imminent deadline, or for a problem affecting tomorrow.
change.new:
Use Urgent when the actual message requires prompt attention because of genuine near-term time pressure, or because delaying review could allow an active or approved business operation to proceed incorrectly and cause an irreversible or costly mistake. A request to stop, hold, cancel, or correct work before it proceeds can establish urgency without an explicit date or time. Assess the supported operational situation, not merely the presence of a change request or forceful wording.

A routine future update, planning-stage revision, general complaint, or information request is Routine when the supplied record supports no near-term deadline or need to prevent an operation from proceeding incorrectly. Do not assume work is already under way merely because an existing order is mentioned.

unchanged: All other prompt text,11 fields/schema/confidence0.80,existing record-change policy,flow rules/connections/fixed Support body and input references. No speculative extra prompt expansion.
stop_rule: One attempt per listed case, in order. Stop further calls and do not revise wording if any preregistered check fails or errors. Test unsaved prompt first; save only if all scoped checks pass. Failed candidate remains archived, not silently deployed.
scope: Classifier prompt tests only; inspect existing flow bindings after saving. No mailbox/workflow run, full batch, prior-run rescoring, human ratings or unrelated tests.
benchmark: One known regression plus4 fresh preregistered robustness probes; not independent generalization or overall release evidence.
preservation: Every existing run/result/score/owner form and scorer/key/contract remains unchanged. Original failed v2 run stays FAIL.
